pages.text: Footwork adds a combat mobility system — dodging, strafing, and positional combat mechanics that reward active movement in fights.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Footwork is available from T1 and changes how every combat encounter feels. Dodge rolling costs stamina and has a cooldown — positioning and timing matter.$(br2)$(bold)Class synergy:$(/bold) Ranger and Samurai classes benefit most from Footwork's mobility options. Berserker and Vanguard can use it defensively to close gaps or disengage.
Craft the $(bold)Combatant's Companion$(/bold) for the full Footwork reference — dodge mechanics, stamina management, keybinds, and advanced movement techniques.
